name: Yamaha MT-07 / FZ-07
engine: 689 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin (CP2), fuel injected
intro: Yamaha's CP2 twin. Sold as the FZ-07 in the US for 2015-2017.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2015 FZ-07s built May to September 2014 are in recall 14V657 for the positive battery cable. Book any open recall with a Yamaha dealer.
A-002.reason: A pinched battery cable can short and start a fire.

add.title: Check the battery cable under the seat
add.instructions: With the seat off, look at the positive battery cable where it runs by the seat base and bracket. It should not be pinched or rubbed through.
add.reason: This is the spot the 2015 recall fixed.

recalls.what: Positive battery cable can be pinched between the seat base and bracket and short.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the cable and seat bracket free.
